origin.note: Historical byte source only. These adopted styles and font assets are now owned by this website; no shared package is installed or required.
origin.adaptation: Only local --lumo-web-* token names, lumoWeb layer names and ownership comments replace the former package names; declarations, values and rules are preserved.

privateAssets.note: Since 9 October 2026 the site lives in the public MIT monorepo. Entries marked private are proprietary (IRANSansX, licensed to the owner for application use) and are NEVER committed: the directory is git-ignored and filled by scripts/prepare-private-fonts.mjs. Only their checksums are public. Without them the build serves a documented system-font fallback for Persian.
